about_variable: [Kafka Common] Comma-separated list of Kafka bootstrap servers.
[Kafka Common] Kafka security protocol (e.g., SASL_PLAINTEXT, SSL).
[Kafka Common] SASL authentication mechanism (e.g., PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-512).
[Kafka Common] SASL username for Kafka authentication.
[Kafka Common] SASL password for Kafka authentication.
[Kafka Common] Kafka Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) topic for failed messages.
[Input Connector] Kafka topic to consume raw order messages from.
[Input Connector] Kafka consumer group ID for the input connector.
[Transformation] Minimum order value required for an order to be processed.
[Transformation] Interval in seconds at which the transformation module processes messages.
[Output Connector] Kafka topic to produce processed order messages to.
